title: The Seventy-Five Aphorisms of Śiva
claim: The shortest complete scripture in the tradition is seventy-five sentences; read one at a time each is a door, and the whole fits in the hand.

purpose.impact: Seventy-five sentences, one per page, until the reader has read a complete scripture without noticing they were studying.
purpose.reader: The gift reader, the first-time reader, and the practitioner who wants the whole text in the hand.
purpose.realisation: The whole path is short enough to hold in mind at once; nothing essential is hidden in commentary.
non_goals: no critical edition and no variant notes

pages.note: 75 sutras at 1/pp + front 10 + glossary 8 + index 6 + end 4 = 103, padded to 108.

sections_plan.purpose: the recognition that ends the search

inclusion: every aphorism of the source, in the source's own order — no selection, no reordering
each page carries the verse (Deva + IAST + English) and one gloss sentence placed from C1
section boundaries follow the text's own chapters; counts are read from the corpus, never assumed
all seventy-five sutras, in the source’s own order, one per page
each gloss is a single sentence placed from C1
exclusion: no aphorism from this text may appear in another book (one verse, one book)
no commentary beyond the single gloss sentence — this is not a critical edition
no facing page, no padding prose, no invented reading
no sutra from this text may appear in another book
no commentary beyond the single gloss sentence

Same cache/receipts pattern as the verse clip. Digital edition plays verse -> how-to per prayer. Planned by factory.py audio; render after owner go.

chant.spec: Per-entry Sanskrit clip in the videofactory speaker format: Fish Audio TTS voice 'verse' (frozen ID 4e873c37d4cb439e9bccc4dc1f633290) reads the entry's IAST line. Render pattern copied from prx0r/videofactory render_chapter: one call per cached group, cache key sha1(voice|text), receipts appended to audio/receipts/calls.jsonl, VOICE_DB -21dB normalization. Planned by factory.py audio; API render only after owner go.

digital.spec: Digital edition for every book: (a) reflowable EPUB from bookkit HTML for Kindle/KDP ebook upload, (b) DRM-free PDF of the build-green interior for direct sale (one-link). Built after the build stage; cover, description and KDP ebook metadata are separate deliverables. Audio clips (verse + how-to) ship alongside when rendered. Customer package = package/ folder (EPUB + PDF + audio + manifest); see BOOKS.md 7b for the physical/Kindle/direct channel map.
